class.name: HEGoInputLineEdit
class.brief_description: A field in the panel's Inputs pane that a scene node can be dragged onto.
class.description: Dropping a node writes its path relative to the edited scene, which is the form the input rows are stored in; typing a path by hand works the same way.

members.member: Unused. The dropped path is written straight to [member text], which is what the panel reads back.

signal.name: input_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a node was dropped on the field, after [member text] has been rewritten.
